newsitem.title: USA: Trade group says mall sales up over Thanksgiving.
newsitem.headline: Trade group says mall sales up over Thanksgiving.

text.p: Sales per square foot in specialty stores at shopping malls in the United States over the Thanksgiving weekend rose by 11.9 percent over the same period last year, according to a national sample of 57 malls reported by the International Council of Shopping Centers (ISCS).
Last year, sales per square foot were flat over the three-day weekend compared with 1994.

The council said that part of the gain should be attributed to the fact that the Thanksgiving weekend fell five days closer to Christmas than it did last year and nearer to the Dec 5 start of the celebration of the Jewish holiday Chanukah.
Also, the council said, the sample reflects increased productivity at malls due to the closing of several underperforming specialty stores that were in Chapter 11 proceedings at this time last year.
